decisions.title: Pause dev outside training
decisions.risk: Quarterly training days must stay online.
decisions.assumption: Idle share estimate is valid outside quarter days.

decisions.title: Pause dev and move to CH
decisions.risk: Location change may need cost and platform sign-off.
decisions.assumption: Move affects only electricity source, not workload.

decisions.title: Pause prod only when safe
decisions.risk: Many daily and month-end jobs limit safe pause windows.
decisions.assumption: Only idle time outside all required windows is paused.

decisions.title: Use GPU only on demand
decisions.risk: Quarterly training days must still work.
decisions.assumption: Current usage pattern stays similar after scheduling.

decisions.title: Use GPU on demand and move
decisions.risk: Move needs confirmation on cost and operational impact.
decisions.assumption: Move changes only grid mix, not runtime or capacity.

extra_measures.title: Retire idle GPU server
extra_measures.description: Decommission srv:gpu-ml-01 if it is no longer needed for quarterly training.
extra_measures.assumption: No hidden workloads depend on this server.

decisions.title: Decommission 3 forgotten servers
decisions.risk: Hidden dependency or missing owner; verify before delete.
decisions.assumption: All three have no required business use.

decisions.title: Run test and QA in office hours
decisions.risk: UAT and GPU workloads may need access outside office hours.
decisions.assumption: Office-hours-only downtime is acceptable for all listed servers.

decisions.title: Downsize vm-test
decisions.risk: Change must wait for freeze and project go-live.
decisions.assumption: Acceptance testing and planned enlargement still require current size.

decisions.title: Downsize vm-test and move
decisions.risk: Move plus resize needs business sign-off and outage planning.
decisions.assumption: AWS CH is available and the move is after freeze.

decisions.title: Move vm-test to Zurich
decisions.risk: No CO2 gain on cost/energy, and timing may disrupt testing.
decisions.assumption: Relocation can wait until continuous availability is no longer required.

extra_measures.title: Move GPU server to Zurich
extra_measures.description: Relocate gpu-ml to CH to cut location-based emissions.
extra_measures.risk: Training days must still work during quarter starts.
extra_measures.assumption: Azure CH is an approved deployment option.

decisions.title: Move cicd to Zurich
decisions.risk: Prod timing and vendor choice need approval.
decisions.assumption: Only grid factor changes; runtime and usage stay equal.

decisions.title: Move st-backup to Zurich
decisions.risk: Backup window and retention obligations need review.
decisions.assumption: Only grid factor changes; data stays and backups continue.

decisions.title: Small model for draft texts
decisions.risk: Quality and user acceptance need a person’s sign-off.
decisions.assumption: 60% of requests move; savings only apply on those requests.

decisions.title: Small model for summaries
decisions.risk: Output quality may change for important summaries.
decisions.assumption: 60% of requests move; savings only apply on those requests.

decisions.title: Small model for translation
decisions.risk: Terminology quality needs spot checks.
decisions.assumption: 60% of requests move; savings only apply on those requests.

decisions.title: Small model for marketing classify
decisions.risk: This was a one-off script bug, not recurring demand.
decisions.assumption: The three-day incident does not justify a yearly measure.

decisions.title: Remove unread tables
decisions.risk: Retention flags are incomplete; owner must confirm deletions.
decisions.assumption: Only verified no-retention tables are removed.

decisions.title: Skip unchanged nightly builds
decisions.risk: Low risk; only suppresses no-change nightlies.
decisions.assumption: Nightly builds with no commits are safely skipped.

decisions.title: Skip builds and move to Zurich
decisions.risk: Relocation needs an owner decision; pipeline behavior is fine.
decisions.assumption: Only grid factor changes; skip logic stays unchanged.

decisions.title: Run reports on request
decisions.risk: Push reporting may be needed for some teams.
decisions.assumption: Unopened reports can be made pull-based.

decisions.title: Shorten log retention
decisions.risk: Legal and troubleshooting needs vary by service.
decisions.assumption: Only services allowed to keep 90 days are changed.

extra_measures.title: Small model for other assistant tasks
extra_measures.description: Default smaller models for remaining expensive assistant tasks after quality review.
extra_measures.risk: Quality impact for contract review needs approval.
extra_measures.assumption: Only a qualified subset of requests can move to small models.

decisions.title: Remove inactive CRM platform seats
decisions.risk: Renewal cut needs owner approval; sales access may be affected.
decisions.assumption: Assumes inactive seats stay unused until renewal.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Chat tool seats
decisions.risk: Team usage may spike around projects; manager should confirm.
decisions.assumption: Assumes inactive seats are not needed for peak cover.

decisions.title: Remove inactive ChatGPT Team seats
decisions.risk: Very high cut; check if shared AI access is needed.
decisions.assumption: Assumes only active users need direct seats.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Design tool seats
decisions.risk: Small team can be blocked if roles overlap; confirm coverage.
decisions.assumption: Assumes remaining users can cover design work.

decisions.title: Remove inactive E-signature seats
decisions.risk: May affect approval flows; legal should confirm signer coverage.
decisions.assumption: Assumes current signers are sufficient after cleanup.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Knowledge base seats
decisions.risk: Access gaps could hurt documentation work; confirm readers/editors.
decisions.assumption: Assumes only active contributors need seats.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Microsoft Copilot seats
decisions.risk: Copilot use may be uneven; business owner should approve.
decisions.assumption: Assumes inactive seats can be dropped without blocking users.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Note-taking tool seats
decisions.risk: Could break shared note access for occasional users; check first.
decisions.assumption: Assumes inactive seats are not needed for read access.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Project management seats
decisions.risk: Project leads may need temporary access; confirm with owners.
decisions.assumption: Assumes inactive users can stay off the tool.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Project scheduling seats
decisions.risk: Scheduling access is operational; confirm backup users first.
decisions.assumption: Assumes removed seats are not needed for peak planning.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Survey tool seats
decisions.risk: Large cut; confirm campaign owners and survey admins.
decisions.assumption: Assumes only one active user needs full access.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Ticket system seats
decisions.risk: Support coverage may drop if occasional agents lose access.
decisions.assumption: Assumes inactive seats are not needed for ticket handling.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Video conferencing tool seats
decisions.risk: Could hinder meeting coverage for occasional hosts; check first.
decisions.assumption: Assumes inactive users do not host or present.

ai_footprint.formula: eq = output (incl. reasoning) + 0.1 × uncached input + 0.01 × cached input (× 0.25 small models); kWh = eq / 1000 × Wh per 1000 tokens (factors.yaml ai_tokens: 0.1 / 0.5 / 2.0); CO2 = kWh × EU grid (0.150 / 0.213 / 0.300 kg/kWh)
ai_footprint.source: measured during this run (token usage returned by the API)
